commonRuntimeCoverage.frameCountScope: Both builds: low-level PCM frames or resampled engine output frames, including own/cross-state/reset continuations; wrapper self-check frames excluded. Engine source frames and the 31-frame pre-restore perturbations are not counted as output frames.
limits: Both variants produce native PCM at floor(clock/64); only the YM2164 Timer B interval is doubled by the existing wrapper. Engine cases separately cover output averaging/holding, without optional PSG/PCM sources.

Cross-build raw states are tested within each variant for these exact builds only; public opaque snapshots remain owner-restricted. Both layouts save selected checkpoints; continuations replay only the regular layout.
Public reset destroys/recreates the native chip and reapplies the JS mute mask; the exported raw reset preserves free-running core counters. Both existing paths are compared.
Status/IRQ/read hooks are sampled at chunk boundaries. Engine generation callbacks are labeled by the enclosing chunk boundary, while PCM resampling runs per output sample.
No Worklet scheduling, physical hardware, browser, Native backend, Mixer or listening judgement is tested.

record.reviewScope: Independent read-only checker review, actual input/report hash verification and recomputed counters. No checker or production edits by reviewer.
reviewedInvariants: Both YM2151 and YM2164 constructors and all 8 physical FM channels / 8 algorithms exercised; raw cross-states exchanged within each variant only.
Timer A first IRQ at frame 4 on both models; Timer B first IRQ 16 on YM2151 and 32 on YM2164; control write clears status and IRQ positively.

Isolated CH8 carrier noise audible at all 32 periods; low/high and noise-off hashes differ; enabling noise leaves CH1 PCM unchanged. Four LFO waveforms give distinct PCM. CSM sounds without ordinary key-on.
Native stereo pan and all-channel mute positively checked. Public reset recreates power-on state and retains JS mute; exported reset preserves original free-running behavior.
Both chunk layouts save selected checkpoints; own/cross/reset continuations replay regular layout. Snapshots restore native mask and Engine held timing with owner restriction.
Hooks operate at synchronous API boundaries; saveState emits no hook events. Engine IRQ callbacks are labelled by enclosing chunk while internal resampling advances per output sample.
Deployment normalization strips only relative ym2151.js / soundchip.js / segapsg.js / segapcm.js query suffixes; actual four wrapper hashes retained.
Owned PCM uses audible data, retuned same-buffer overwrite and explicit capacity+1 generation with capacity-increase assertion; held data remains unchanged.
Main output frames, wrapper raw frames and pre-restore perturbation output frames remain separate; all counters independently recompute.
